facts.fact: Al-Ahram Weekly (22 September 2026) reports that President Sisi's directive to accelerate the 5G rollout, expand large-scale data centres and scale up AI and cloud infrastructure forms part of a wider digital transformation strategy, with targets of $8 billion in digital exports by 2028, $12 billion in outsourcing exports by 2029 and 120 electronics design companies by 2030 agreed at a ministerial meeting the previous week.

note: Class is empty because the document does not describe the strategy's scope; the one fact is an event in the last twelve months. No standing, period, plan or reporting stated.
